g.text: A strong model must be assessed with several metrics
MAE and RMSE: lower is better. Signed bias = prediction − actual; closer to zero is better.
Source: models/oof_metrics_pooled.csv. All values are events per province-time cell.
Always-zero achieves the lowest 6h MAE in these sparse data, but predicts no events; HGB does not win every metric.
